description: DemandCast is Open Energy Transition's Python workflow for retrieving, checking and forecasting hourly electricity demand. It combines public demand series with weather, population and economic inputs, trains machine-learning models and exports demand time series. The repository's released forecast dataset covers 184 countries from 2000 to 2024; users can generate future scenarios independently from the code. The spatial unit is mainly a country, while subnational forecasting is listed as future work. Source is free under AGPL-3.0; the separate forecast data deposit has its own terms and address. A limitation is that retrieval modules and source coverage differ by country. Some upstream data sources or API calls may need their own credentials. Container and uv instructions support reuse, but this review did not run training, request upstream data or download forecasts. The workflow prepares electricity-load inputs for power-system capacity and resilience studies. It is a forecast-generation platform, not the published forecast dataset itself.
